content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before signing. Specifically: - Regarding the clause stating "The parties intend to allow 15 rounds of ordinary revisions for the principal creative Deliverables.", this allows an unusually high number of revisions; please change it so that the agreement states: "The parties agree to include up to two rounds of revisions for each principal Deliverable, with additional revisions subject to a written change order." - Regarding the clause stating "Invoices are payable Net 60.", a 60-day payment term delays cash flow significantly; please change it so that the agreement states: "Invoices are payable Net 30." - Regarding the clause stating "Revision allowance: 15 rounds", 15 rounds is excessive; please change it so that the agreement states: "Revision allowance: 3 rounds". - Regarding the clause stating "Payment period: Net 60", waiting two months for payment is too long; please change it so that the agreement states: "Payment period: Net 30." Please let me know if these adjustments are acceptable. Best regards.
